decisions.reason: Pandemic-hit aviation demand likely left the mobile check-in app below aspirations and slack is thin, but recovering travel in 2022 and the push for contactless processing give management reason to hold it for now rather than search for alternatives.

PassBoard was a flagship launch tied to the firm's core airport passenger-processing position, and post-COVID demand for efficient, touchless processing makes it likely to meet the firm's lowered aspirations, so it stays.

The self-service check-in solution probably underperformed during the travel collapse, but it complements the firm's integrated airport offering and fits the recovery's demand for automation, so management is likely to keep it despite limited slack.
